result.stdout:
USAGE:
    sharpsql [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init               Install and configure SharpSql.Sdk in a console project  
    conformance        Measure SharpSql transpilation coverage (not runtime     
                       semantic conformance) against the Mono C# compiler test  
                       corpus                                                   
    publish <INPUT>    Compile and publish a versioned SharpSql application to  
                       SQL Server                                               
    run                Transpile and execute a project or generated SQL using a 
                       SQL Server connection or Testcontainer                   
    transpile          Transpile a C# source file or SDK-style project into a   
                       T-SQL program batch                                      
    unpublish          Remove an installed SharpSql application from SQL Server 
    verify             Run C# locally and generated SQL in a SQL Server         
                       Testcontainer, then compare outcomes

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install and configure SharpSql.Sdk in a console project

USAGE:
    sharpsql init [PROJECT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [PROJECT]    A console .csproj or a directory containing one. Uses the      
                 current directory when omitted                                 

OPTIONS:
                                              DEFAULT                           
    -h, --help                                                   Prints help    
                                                                 information    
    -o, --output <PATH>                                          MSBuild path   
                                                                 for generated  
                                                                 SQL. Defaults  
                                                                 beside the     
                                                                 compiled       
                                                                 application    
        --entry <METHOD>                                         Entry method in
                                                                 Namespace.Type:
                                                                 :Method form.  
                                                                 The console    
                                                                 entry point is 
                                                                 used by default
        --sdk-version <VERSION>                                  SharpSql.Sdk   
                                                                 package        
                                                                 version.       
                                                                 Defaults to the
                                                                 installed tool 
                                                                 version        
        --analyzer-only

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Measure SharpSql transpilation coverage (not runtime semantic conformance) 
against the Mono C# compiler test corpus

USAGE:
    sharpsql conformance [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                DEFAULT                                         
    -h, --help                                            Prints help           
                                                          information           
    -p, --parallel <WORKERS>                              Maximum tests compiled
                                                          concurrently (defaults
                                                          to the available      
                                                          processor count)      
        --baseline                                        Replace the saved     
                                                          baseline with the     
                                                          results of this run   
        --tests <DIRECTORY>                               Use a specific Mono   
                                                          test corpus directory 
    -o, --output <FILE>                                   Detailed JSON results 
                                                          file (defaults to     
                                                          tests/conformance/resu
                                                          lts.json)             
        --timeout <SECONDS>     10                        Transpilation timeout 
                                                          for each test;        
                                                          timed-out worker      
                                                          processes are         
                                                          terminated            
        --semantic <COUNT>                                Execute and compare up
                                                          to COUNT observable   
  
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Compile and publish a versioned SharpSql application to SQL Server

USAGE:
    sharpsql publish <INPUT> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <INPUT>    A .cs source file or SDK-style .csproj project

OPTIONS:
                                              DEFAULT                           
    -h, --help                                           Prints help information
        --schema <SCHEMA>                                Application SQL schema.
                                                         Defaults to            
                                                         sharpsql_<application  
                                                         name>                  
        --name <NAME>                                    Application name.      
                                                         Defaults to the input  
                                                         file or project name   
        --version <VERSION>                   1.0.0      Published application  
                                                         version                
        --entry <METHOD>                                 Project entry method in
                                                         Namespace.Type::Method 
                                                         form                   
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>       Release    MSBuild project        
                                                         configuration          
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                          Target framework to    
                                                         select for a           
                                                         multi-targeted project 
        --connection <NAME>                              Connection string name 
                                                         from environment, user 
                                                         secrets, or appsettings
        --connection-string-env <VARIABLE>

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Transpile a C# source file or SDK-style project into a T-SQL program batch

USAGE:
    sharpsql transpile [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    A .cs or .csproj input. Reads C# from standard input when omitted

OPTIONS:
                                           DEFAULT                              
    -h, --help                                          Prints help information 
    -o, --output <PATH>                                 Write generated SQL to a
                                                        file instead of standard
                                                        output                  
        --installer-output <PATH>                       Write standalone runtime
                                                        provisioning SQL to this
                                                        file                    
        --entry <METHOD>                                Project entry method in 
                                                        Namespace.Type::Method  
                                                        form                    
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>    Release      MSBuild project         
                                                        configuration           
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                         Target framework to     
                                                        select for a            
                                                        multi-targeted project  
        --runtime-storage <MODE>           Ephemeral    Runtime state mode:     
                                                        Ephemeral (default),    
                                                        MemoryOptimized,        
                                                        Durable, or             
                                                        ServiceBroker           
        --native-kernels                                Extract supported pure  
                          
[truncated]

DESCRIPTION:
Run C# locally and generated SQL in a SQL Server Testcontainer, then compare 
outcomes

USAGE:
    sharpsql verify [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    A .cs or .csproj input. Reads C# from standard input when omitted

OPTIONS:
                                           DEFAULT                              
    -h, --help                                                  Prints help     
                                                                information     
        --entry <METHOD>                                        Project entry   
                                                                method in       
                                                                Namespace.Type::
                                                                Method form     
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>    Release              MSBuild project 
                                                                configuration   
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                                 Target framework
                                                                to select for a 
                                                                multi-targeted  
                                                                project         
        --sql-output <PATH>                                     Write the       
                                                                generated SQL to
                                                                a file,         
                                                                including when  
                                                                verification    
                                                                fails           
        --image <IMAGE>                    mcr.microsoft.com    SQL Server      
                                           /mssql/server:202    Testcontainer   
                                           2-latest             image           
        --timeout
